title: EEF CNA OSV affected database_specific and ecosystem_specific
description: The affected source files, modules and routines of one affected[] entry of an EEF CNA OSV record. EEF CNA records put this object in affected[].database_specific, and for Hex packages also in affected[].ecosystem_specific. The values come from the programFiles, modules and programRoutines fields of the matching CVE affected[] entry. The OSV schema (https://ossf.github.io/osv-schema/) defines these fields and leaves their contents to the database and the ecosystem.

$schema.description: URL of the schema version that the object conforms to.

program_files.description: Affected source files. Paths are relative to the root of the package or repository that the affected[] entry describes.

modules.description: Affected modules, by the name the language uses for them.

program_routines.description: Affected functions. Erlang and Elixir functions use Erlang notation module:function/arity.
